description: Authoritative governance classification for every Edge Function surface, repo-side and live-side. The release manifest generator refuses to produce a manifest if any repo directory or known live-only function is missing a classification here - no surface is silently ignored, and no QUARANTINED/HERITAGE surface is ever pulled into a release.

classes.GOVERNED: Included in the release manifest. Source-hashed, release-tracked.
classes.QUARANTINED: Deliberately excluded by governance decision. Never included in a release, never deployed by release automation.
classes.HERITAGE_UNMANAGED: Live on a project with no repository source at any point in git history. Cannot be source-attributed or release-managed. Excluded, permanently, unless source is recovered.
classes.EXCLUDED_WITH_REASON: Repo source exists but is deliberately not part of the backend release set.

scan-identify.reason: Core scanner backend. Already under content-hash coverage in config/edge-function-manifest.json.

stylechat-generate.reason: Core Elise/StyleChat backend. Already under content-hash coverage in config/edge-function-manifest.json.

style-outfit-generate.reason: Elise outfit generation. Deployed to both projects; extends coverage beyond the prior two-function manifest.

process-account-deletions.reason: Account-deletion worker. Note: its scheduling trigger is not visible to this repository (see docs/release/BACKEND_RELEASE_DISCOVERY.md).

resend-restoration-email.reason: Restoration email path. Known open gap: no rate limit or dedup guard (see discovery).

stylist-speech.reason: Stylist voice surface. Live production entrypoint_path indicates a past local-CLI deploy from a developer worktree - a provenance concern recorded in discovery, not a governance exclusion.

staging-health.reason: Reclassified from EXCLUDED_WITH_REASON in Phase 2B. It now hosts the health contract (/health/live, /health/ready, /version) and serves the authoritative live release identity that exact-candidate verification reads, so its source is release-critical: a change to it changes what the release reports about itself. Still deployed to staging only - `environments` scopes the deploy target, `class` scopes release governance, and the two are deliberately independent.

product-match.reason: Governed quarantine boundary (Issue #46 / Issue #72 product-match provenance). Live on staging only, correctly absent from staging/production-parity. Must never be pulled into a release set.

privacy-controls.reason: Website-heritage function from the project's prior life as 'K Scan Privacy Controls'. Live on staging only, with zero repository source at any point in git history - it cannot be source-attributed or release-managed. Documented in docs/security/public-ingress-inventory.md.

public-sale-share-opt-out.reason: Website-heritage function, same provenance situation as privacy-controls. Live on staging only, no repository source ever.

notes: _shared is not a function; it is hashed separately and its digest is attached to every GOVERNED function entry, because a change there can alter the behaviour of functions whose own directory is untouched.

This file governs release INCLUSION. It is not a deployment allowlist and does not itself deploy anything. security/staging/provenance-exceptions.json remains the staging deploy-time quarantine mechanism.
